Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay. I'm the drievr of the car that got hit from behind.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a light on the main road heading toward the shopping center. It was a regular weekday afternoon,
traffic was moving slow.
Q: What happened next?
A: The light was red and I had my foot on the brake. Then there was a hard impact from behind. My head snapped
forward and then back into the headrest. The car lurched into the intersection a little bit.
Q: Did the airbags deploy, and did you hit anything else?
A: No airbags went off. I didn't hit anything else, just the impact from the back.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I got out and walked aorund for a minute, but my neck was already stiff and my lower back was sore. I sat down on
the curb until the police arrived.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since then?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They told me I had a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical
therapy twice a week and taking something for the pain.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes. Turning my head to the left is the worst. I get a dull ache in my lower back when I sit too long, and I've had
trouble sleeping a few nights.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I was following the rules and stopped where I was supposed to. I just want my car fixed and my treatment
covered.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
